summary: iter130 — Verified Customer Expo Wallet (/(customer)/wallet) and NEW Invoices (/(customer)/invoices) pages as ports of web WalletView/WalletTopup/ScratchCardsPanel and InvoiceCenter. Only automation-layer caveats around PanResponder scratch drag on RN-web; and email send returns backend 400 (expected — email not configured; UI does not crash, per spec).

POST /api/invoices/{id}/email returned 400 (backend email not configured) but UI did not crash — matches spec ('success or backend error — both acceptable').
frontend_verified.Regression: /(customer)/orders still loads with page-title='My Bookings'. No 'VirtualizedLists should never be nested' warnings observed in console on wallet or invoices during the test run (only benign expo-notifications and useNativeDriver warnings).

minor.issue: Returns 400 (email backend not configured in preview env). UI handles gracefully; likely by design for dev — flag only for prod readiness.

critical_code_review_comments: invoices.tsx uses OptionMenu whose PillTrigger auto-appends '-trigger' to the given testID. Spec/task description referenced 'invoice-paystatus-filter' but the actual DOM testID is 'invoice-paystatus-filter-trigger' (consistent with invoice-type-filter-trigger). Consider clarifying in docs/spec, or expose both testIDs for clarity.

Scratch reveal via PanResponder was not automatable via headless mouse drag on RN-web. If future E2E automation of the scratch flow is required, consider adding a testID hook or dev-only 'reveal' shortcut on scratch-canvas (e.g., double-click) for automated verification without altering user UX.

Email send endpoint (/api/invoices/{id}/email) returning 400 in preview should have a clearer error surface (e.g., 501 Not Implemented) or a mocked success response for dev builds — current UX silently swallows or shows a toast, but user can't distinguish 'not configured' from 'invalid email'.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 pytest — auth, scratch, wallet get/topup, invoices list/sort/detail/share)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on functional acceptance set (wallet balance+topup, KPIs, filters; invoices list/search/sort/filters/detail/full preview/share/email; scratch modal opens). One automation caveat: PanResponder canvas drag reveal not verified via headless mouse.
